name: Fuwari Complex
original_name: ふわりコンプレックス
source:
One day, a big restaurant chain suddenly makes a proposal to the restaurants located in the town Kazuha lives. It is a mahjong battle royale a restaurant that wins can take over a restaurant owned by an opponent. Almost all of restaurants in the town decide to take part in it to protect themselves. Kazuha also goes in for the battle...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
某天，一家大型连锁餐饮企业突然向一叶所在城镇的各家餐厅提出一项建议：举行麻将大逃杀，获胜餐厅可以吞并对手的店铺。为了自保，镇上几乎所有餐厅都决定参加，一叶也投身战斗……

[摘自ErogeShop]
